$comment: 🪪️ The record a verification seals beside the change journal: the cursor at which the world last matched what was verified, tied to the identity (`key`) of what was verified. Texts of the refusals are those of the change journal itself.

linked.$comment: the workspace-relative directories above the verified paths that are symbolic links: a change made through a link is reported at its target, so nothing below one is vouched by path

Mode.$comment: journal: proves against the cursor sealed by an earlier verification; cursor: only the point a verification in progress starts from; walk: no journal answer, nothing is proven.
